deed-intake.title: Deed intake
deed-intake.summary: Reads the facts for the deed from the documents

questions.agreement: Upload the signed sale agreement and what the parties sent (the earlier deed, the certificates). Then continue.
questions.missing: The documents don't mention {label}. What is it? Leave empty if you don't know yet.

company-formation.title: Company formation
company-formation.summary: Reads the facts for the deed of incorporation of a BV from the founders' documents
company-formation.factsTitle: Facts for the deed of incorporation

questions.identity: Upload the founders' identity documents (or a company's extract from the register). Then continue.
questions.plan: Upload the financial plan and what the founders decided: name, seat, object, shares, directors. Then continue.
questions.kind_known: The documents don't say how the founders contribute. In cash, in kind, or both?
questions.bank: Upload the bank certificate of the blocked account. If the contribution is in kind, say there is none.
questions.reports: Upload the auditor's report and the founders' report on the contribution in kind. Then continue.
questions.missing: The documents don't mention {label}. What is it? Leave empty if you don't know yet.
questions.missing.founders: The documents name no founders. Who are they? Give each founder's name, shares and contribution, or leave empty if you don't know yet.
questions.missing.contribution_kind: The documents don't say how the founders contribute. In cash, in kind, or both?

checks.shares_add_up: The founders' shares add up to the shares issued
checks.contributions_add_up: The founders' contributions add up to the contribution in money
checks.bank_certifies_the_contribution: The bank certifies the contribution in money
checks.a_founder: There is at least one founder

steps.reports: Reports on the contribution in kind
